description: Model-document version states (DEL-02-05 CLM-003; DEL-02-01 Design model-document-0.8.0.md §3.1): each case's schema_version (absent when the case has none) and the state, versions, detail and refusal code every version check gives. Components compare as digit strings (leading zeros dropped, then by length, then digit by digit), so a component of any length has a defined state; only the exact current string is current. Invented test data; checked by the applier (model_document_version.rs), the desktop (src-tauri model_document_version.rs, projectService.ts) and Python persistence.
